name: Shenzhen Sunway Communication Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Sunway Communication Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of antennas and modules, wireless charging modules and related products, EMI/EMC devices, precision connectors, and acoustic devices in China and internationally. The company offers RF connectivity products, such as antennas, transmission lines, spring contacts, and connectivity modules; wireless charging products, including RX, TX, and magnetic materials; and precision components comprising stamping, MIM/CIM, molding, and MID.
